## Current rule

Link `docs/PRD.md` or `docs/decisions.md`.

## Proposed change and why

State the user impact, evidence, and alternatives. Do not implement the change before the owner decides.

## Owner answer

Record the answer here, then update the canonical docs in the same pull request as the change.
